consequence.statement: If the legacy metrics are in use (ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS=true), monitoring dashboards and alerts must be updated to use argocd_app_info labels before upgrading, since the old metrics are removed.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards and alerts to use the labels on argocd_app_info before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The legacy metrics argocd_app_sync_status, argocd_app_health_status and argocd_app_created_time are removed in 3.0.0; use labels on argocd_app_info instead, which matters if ARGOCD_LEGACY_CONTROLLER_METRICS is set to true.
